components.notes: backlog #697: the SHIPPED corpus of walkthrough decision 5 (docs/marketplace/decision-5-suspect-files.md), listed file by file because a directory entry cannot leave a file out: every tracked docs/memory/ file except the 16 of groups A-C, the 6 of group D and MEMORY.md (each an exclusion below), plus each D file's paraphrase from docs/marketplace/shipped-corpus/. It is build-shipped-corpus.py's output less MEMORY.md: the tracked raw index links the excluded files, and the builder's filtered index (which links none) is not a tracked file, so mkt_stage.py, which stages tracked files at their repository paths, cannot ship it (backlog #707, decided at plan Task 21). The six paraphrases install at docs/marketplace/shipped-corpus/, outside docs/memory/ (backlog #707). check-shipping-sets.py --closure refuses any package that ships a file named for an A-C file or carrying an A-D source's bytes, and runs build-shipped-corpus.py --check over the corpus files a package ships, so no group-D quote ships unparaphrased. A memory file added later is a --map gap until it is listed here or excluded, and the declaration is re-derived (mkt_stage.py --declare).
